outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence images of lungs, not a plot of averaged data.
The bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity (mean ± SD) already overlays the individual data points for each mouse (blue dots for No Cre, red dots for Adeno Cre).
Panel C consists of histology/RNAscope images and spatial transcriptomics expression maps, not a plot summarizing averaged values across replicates.
GSEA enrichment plots display a running enrichment score derived from a ranked gene list, not a mean of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.

The bar graph shows log2 fold-change values per gene from a differential expression (Wilcoxon rank-sum) analysis of spatial transcriptomics data; each bar is a computed statistic rather than a mean of independent biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
